description: P2 numerical robustness (dt and N) on a common bimodal separation ladder

estimator.stopping_rule: first lag tau with rho^2(tau) <= 1/N, included (paper eq:tmax_stopping)

rng_policy: all RNG on CPU generator (per-step torch.randn(n,d)), tensors moved to device; no device-side RNG, so cpu/cuda runs are comparable

max_lag_cap_validation.note: Caps are evaluated post-hoc from the full-window rho^2; no cap is adopted.
